correctness.rationale: All 16-vertex graph distances and every relevant simplex are exhaustively computed by the standalone standard-library verifier. A 130-step certificate gives 118 acyclic Morse pairs and critical cells 1 in degree zero, 9 in degree two, 2 in degree three. The complete Hasse DAG is checked independently. Two disjoint oriented crosspolytope-boundary three-cycles are primitive integral classes and force zero degree-three Morse differential, so the two-skeleton plus nullhomotopic three-cell attachments is the stated mixed wedge. Distance-four pairs are a perfect matching, yielding the seven-sphere at radius three. No four-simplices occur at radius two and no unproved infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The sixteen-vertex Möbius–Kantor graph is a canonical symmetric cubic generalized Petersen and incidence graph. The complete shortest-path Rips filtration is a motivated natural invariant, and its scale-two mixed-dimensional homotopy, nine two-spheres plus two geometrically canonical three-spheres, is neither a routine graph Betti number nor an arbitrary parameter slice. It resolves a concrete gap left by inapplicable large-girth and edge-disjoint-six-cycle theorems and supplies a full exact integral barcode, with natural uses for testing graph-metric topological thickening against standard criteria.
